title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
abstract: arXiv:2611.31284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act.   In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties.   We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure compos

translated_title: 自主智能体系统的不可约简治理结构：公平分配、策略防操纵性与多尺度组合
translated_abstract: 自主智能体治理通常被表述为强制正确执行的问题。然而，在多智能体系统中，一个同样根本的问题先于执行而存在：哪些智能体被允许行动。本文证明，分配并非辅助性问题，而是治理的结构性组成部分。当多个智能体在受限资源下竞争执行权时，任何分配机制都会在公平性、效率和抗策略操纵性之间引入不可避免的权衡。我们通过一系列不可能性结果将这一点形式化，包括女巫攻击放大效应以及理想分配属性之间的互不相容性。随后，我们进一步证明这些分配约束无法在单一控制层内得到解决；相反，它们会在整个系统中传播，与执行原子性、状态强制以及行为漂移相互作用。这最终导向一个多尺度的组合式治理结构。
tldr: 本文证明了在多智能体系统中，执行权的分配是治理的结构性核心，公平性、效率与抗策略操纵之间存在不可能性权衡，且这些约束会跨系统层级传播，因而必须构建多尺度组合式治理结构。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that agent allocation is a structural component of governance in multi-agent systems, with impossibility trade-offs among fairness, efficiency, and strategy-proofness that propagate across control layers, necessitating a multi-scale compositional governance structure.
